metadata.description: Unofficial Anthropic University learning plugin by Patrick King for Claude Code, the Claude desktop app, and Claude chat: certification prep for all four Claude exams plus 13 learning lanes, including partner tracks. Not affiliated with Anthropic.

plugins.name: anthropic-university
plugins.description: Learn Claude end to end: study plans and role paths, 13 learning lanes (use, build, administer, partner & industry), adaptive quizzes, official-format mock exams, flashcards, cheat sheets, concept explainers, answer grading, client role-play for partners, Quizlet/Anki export, and contributor tools. Mapped to the official exam guides and grounded live through Claude Code Docs, Microsoft Learn, Agent Skills, the Anthropic Economic Index, and Claude Docs connectors, with a bundled helper script and banks for all four certification tracks.
